title: OpenGlass Policy v1
description: A versioned, vendor-neutral format for classifying agent actions by risk. A policy is a flat list of rules matched in order against one event; the highest risk level among matched rules wins, falling back to defaultRisk when nothing matches. See ../README.md for the full guide.

defaultRisk.description: The risk level for an event that matches no rule. Defaults to "low" if omitted.

rules.description: Rule ids must be unique within a policy; this is enforced by the reference evaluators, not expressible in JSON Schema alone.

id.description: Unique, kebab-case within the policy. Stable across policy edits — downstream systems may key off it.

reasons.description: Human-readable explanations surfaced in the evaluation result when this rule matches.

condition.description: A leaf match against one field, or a boolean combination of sub-conditions. Exactly one of the leaf shape or {all}/{any}/{not} must be used.

field.description: "attr:<key>" does an exact-key lookup in the event's OpenTelemetry GenAI attributes (keys are flat and may themselves contain dots, e.g. "attr:gen_ai.tool.name"). "field:<path>" does a dotted-path lookup into the event's plain fields (e.g. "field:payload.amountUsd").

value.description: Required for every op except exists/not_exists. "in"/"not_in" take an array; "matches" takes a regular expression string (case-insensitive with an inline (?i) flag); the rest take a scalar.
